name: narrated-deck-studio
description: Consent-first local production of vetted narrated PowerPoints and videos from a folder of source material.
long_description: Lets Claude Cowork safely inventory an approved folder, clarify and review a series plan, orchestrate editable PowerPoint authoring, clone an authorised voice locally, align narration, and release reviewed PPTX, PPSX and MP4 deliverables. Human approval is required at four gates.

tools.name: draft_series_plan
tools.description: Create an unapproved plan from the user's answers.

tools.name: open_review
tools.description: Open the local human approval page.

tools.name: request_revision
tools.description: Record an edit and invalidate downstream approvals.
